[[File:Palace-schematics.jpg|thumb|180px|Schematics of the Palace and its immediate vicinity, including the pyramid.]]
The '''Ambassadorial habitation pyramid''' was a building located in the [[Palace District]] on [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]]. It was over 1600 square meters in area,<ref name="NJOSB">''[[The New Jedi Order Sourcebook]]''</ref> and presumably hosted many [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Ambassador/Legends|ambassadors]], perhaps [[Senator/Legends|senators]] and other dignitaries. The [[pyramid]] was but a short distance from the [[Imperial Palace/Legends|Palace]], and thus much closer to the main residence of [[Galactic Emperor/Legends|Emperor]] [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]] than other residential buildings like the [[500 Republica/Legends|500 Republica]] or the [[Senate apartment complex/Legends|Senate Apartment Complex]].

{{Struct-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
This pyramid was first seen on a conceptual image by [[Ralph McQuarrie]] depicting the surroundings of the Imperial Palace.
